purpose: Executable backlog for taking GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro from planning manifests to per-die, AI-core, memory and network replay.

scope.metricPolicy: No validated TPS is produced until the model-specific ledger, replay and provenance gates pass.
scope.evidencePolicy: Planning estimates, validated replay and silicon observation remain separate evidence classes.

distinctRisks: FP8 checkpoint storage versus deployed FP8 KV/index layout
MTP draft/verify/rollback path and acceptance-rate evidence
TP-only MoE decision must be proven against the runtime lowering
reported 49B active and 1.6T total parameter figures do not reconcile under current assumptions
DeepSeek-V3/V3.2 dimensions are assumptions pending an official config
FP4 expert encoding, scale granularity and dequant/accumulate cost
per-layer indexer traffic and sparse-attention state
six routed experts plus one shared expert under TP-only placement

requiredOutputs: qualified shape manifest with source hashes
explicit TP/EP/CP/PP and MTP deployment decision
acceptance: Every shape and precision field has a versioned source or remains explicitly BLOCKED_CONFIG
full/shared indexer layer sets reconcile with the reference implementation
FP8 weight, KV and index-key storage formats are separately identified
MTP acceptance, rollback and commit semantics are either measured or excluded with a named blocker
blockedWhen: official config or checkpoint metadata is unavailable
TP/EP/CP/PP layout is not explicit

inputs: official FP4 encoding and scale specification
requiredOutputs: qualified shape manifest with source hashes
acceptance: 61-layer, hidden, head, expert and indexer fields reconcile to one versioned source
active-parameter and total-parameter solutions are registered as separate variants, never silently averaged
FP4 scale granularity, dequant path and accumulation dtype are explicit
the 49B versus 1.6T discrepancy is resolved or remains a blocking variant range
blockedWhen: official config/checkpoint metadata is unavailable
FP4 storage semantics are unspecified
parameter variants are not separately identifiable

inputs: reference model trace or equivalent operator trace
acceptance: Each operator row carries operator_id, layer type/count, shape, dtype, FLOPs, weight/activation/expert/KV/index bytes and source hash
router selection, active experts, shared expert and capacity overflow are explicit
MTP draft/verify/rollback work is either represented or explicitly excluded
FLOP and byte totals conserve against the layer and parameter ledgers
blockedWhen: a required operator or dtype has no source
trace cannot distinguish full/shared/indexer layer behavior

acceptance: Every collective has a name, count per token, payload bytes per rank, peer/rank scaling, algorithm and phase count
requests, ACK/control bytes, workspace and packet alignment are included
full/shared/indexer layer differences are represented; TP16 and TP32 are not inferred from one scalar
payload conservation holds from logical tensor bytes to wire bytes and routed bytes
blockedWhen: parallelism or algorithm is unspecified
only an aggregate collective count exists
payload cannot be reconciled to the operator trace

acceptance: Dense, router, expert, indexer, sparse-attention and reduce kernels have separate cycle/resource models
FP8/FP4 dequant, scale load and accumulation are non-zero modeled costs
peak, effective and calibrated throughput are separate fields with evidence class
single-die, TP16 and TP32 results identify core, SRAM, NoC, MC or collective bottlenecks without emitting an unqualified global TPS
blockedWhen: operator or collective ledger is blocked
core mapping or dtype kernel cost is missing

acceptance: KV_STATE, SPARSE_INDEX_CACHE, EXPERT_STAGING and MTP_BRANCH_STATE have independent size/lifetime/priority rows
capacity, sustained bandwidth, burst bandwidth and DMA efficiency are separate
each model reports the performance delta for SRAM size and bandwidth changes, with the changed input and seed recorded
overflow, eviction, prefetch miss and stale-epoch counts are visible
blockedWhen: state layout or buffer lifetime is unspecified
SRAM/MC bandwidth cannot be tied to an operator or transfer

acceptance: Indexer, attention, MoE output, router/control and MTP traffic are separately attributed
logical payload, protocol wire bytes, routed bytes and link capacity reconcile
P50/P95/P99 are only reported when a queueing or trace source exists; otherwise the artifact stays BLOCKED_CONFIG
topology selection and Gate status are not written by the network kernel
blockedWhen: per-collective payload ledger is missing
queueing/credit parameters are missing

acceptance: TP/EP/CP/PP, expert placement, index-cache prefetch and collective overlap are explicit
software gains carry a measurable implementation prerequisite and are not inserted as TPS multipliers
MTP acceptance/rollback is replayable for both success and rejection paths
kernel fusion, prefetch and scheduler assumptions are recorded in the trace
blockedWhen: ABI or Tile IR lowering is missing
overlap claim has no traceable schedule

acceptance: No artifact with missing provenance is treated as a pass
active/total parameter variants remain distinguishable in every downstream artifact
planning, validated replay and silicon observation never share one status
Q-Gate remains BLOCKED_CONFIG until all required model-specific rows and traces exist
blockedWhen: any upstream artifact is stale, unverifiable or materially mismatched

acceptance: Every candidate number points to model, variant, TP, MC profile, seed, units and evidence class
SRAM, compute, MC and network trade-offs are shown per model rather than averaged
a blocked model blocks claims that require that model; it does not silently disappear from selection
candidate selection and Gate decisions remain in the governance evaluator
blockedWhen: model lanes are not comparable by a common contract
V&V evidence is incomplete

exitStates.meaning: Required shape, precision, deployment or protocol input is absent or contradictory; no detailed performance claim is allowed.
All rows exist with explicit assumptions and conservation checks, but at least one input is not vendor/config verified.
Model-specific trace, provenance, conservation and regression checks pass for the declared scope.
Measured silicon evidence is linked; it does not overwrite planning or replay results.
